# chameleon_contract (Data Source)

Look up a data contract by ID or by catalog/namespace/table.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a contract by its ID.
data "chameleon_contract" "by_id" {
  id = "5f7c8b53-1f1e-4f8b-92dc-9c3d7c8a4d20"
}

# Or look up by catalog/namespace/table.
data "chameleon_contract" "for_orders_table" {
  catalog   = "analytics"
  namespace = "curated"
  table     = "orders"
}

output "orders_contract_status" {
  value = data.chameleon_contract.for_orders_table.status
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `catalog` (String)
- `id` (String) Contract ID. Provide id OR catalog+namespace+table.
- `namespace` (String)
- `table` (String)

### Read-Only

- `yaml_content` (String)
